translations.literal: When Hailing moved the imperial tombs to Mount Dafang, because Talan had once attended Taizu, he ordered a stone image made and placed before Ruizong's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing moved the imperial tombs to Mount Dafang, he ordered a stone image of Talan — who had once served Emperor Taizu in person — placed before Prince Ruizong's tomb.

sentences.zh: 章宗即位，坐與御史大夫唐括貢為壽，犯夜禁，奪官一階，罷。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhangzong took the throne, for celebrating a birthday with Censor-in-Chief Tangutuo Gong and violating the night curfew, he was stripped of one rank and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhangzong took the throne, Bian was demoted one rank and dismissed for celebrating a birthday with Censor-in-Chief Tangutuo Gong in violation of the night curfew.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年，起為同知棣州防禦使事，上書曆詆宰執。

translations.literal: In the first year of Mingchang he was recalled as Associate Defense Commissioner of Di Prefecture and submitted a memorial enumerating and denouncing the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Mingchang (1190) he was recalled as Associate Defense Commissioner of Di Prefecture and submitted a memorial denouncing the chief ministers one by one.

sentences.zh: 帝以小臣敢譏訕宰輔，杖八十，削一官，罷之，發還本猛安。

translations.literal: The emperor, because a minor official dared to mock the chief ministers, had him beaten eighty strokes, stripped one rank, dismissed him, and sent him back to his home meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had him beaten eighty strokes, stripped of one rank, and dismissed for daring as a minor official to ridicule the chief ministers, then sent him back to his home meng'an.

sentences.zh: 明年，隆授同知宣德州事。

translations.literal: The next year he was ceremonially appointed Associate Prefect of Xuande.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he received a ceremonial appointment as Associate Prefect of Xuande.

sentences.zh: 召授武衛軍副都指揮使，四遷知大興府事，轉左右宣徽使。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Deputy Commander of the Martial Guard Army, transferred four times to Prefect of Daxing, and changed to Commissioner of the Left and Right Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to court, he was appointed Deputy Commander of the Martial Guard Army, promoted four times to Prefect of Daxing, and made Commissioner of the Left and Right Palaces.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，拜尚書右丞，出為泰定軍節度使，移知濟南府。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an he was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, sent out as Military Commissioner of the Taiding Army, and moved to Prefect of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Cheng'an (1197) he was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, sent out as Military Commissioner of the Taiding Army, and transferred to Prefect of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 弈為人貪鄙，數以贓敗，帝愛其能治圍場，故進而委信之。

translations.literal: Yi was greedy and base in character and repeatedly failed for corruption; the emperor loved his ability to manage the hunting parks, and therefore promoted and entrusted him.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was greedy and base, and was repeatedly implicated in corruption; the emperor valued his skill in managing the hunting parks and therefore continued to promote and trust him.

sentences.zh: 阿喜，宗室子，好學問。

translations.literal: A Xi, a son of the imperial clan, loved learning.
translations.idiomatic: A Xi, a member of the imperial clan, was fond of learning.

sentences.zh: 襲父北京路筈柏山猛安，聽訟明決，人信而愛之。

translations.literal: He inherited his father's meng'an at Gaboshan on the Northern Capital circuit; in hearing lawsuits he was clear and decisive, and people trusted and loved him.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited his father's meng'an at Gaboshan on the Northern Capital circuit; his judgments were clear and decisive, and the people trusted and loved him.

sentences.zh: 察廉能，除彰國軍節度副使，改上京留守判官。

translations.literal: Recognized for integrity and ability, he was appointed Deputy Military Commissioner of the Zhangguo Army and changed to Associate Defender of the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Recognized for integrity and ability, he was appointed Deputy Military Commissioner of the Zhangguo Army and then Associate Defender of the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 提刑司奏彰國軍治狀，遷同知速頻路節度事，改歸德軍，曆海、邳二州刺史，皆兼總押軍馬。

translations.literal: The Judicial Commission reported his record of governance in the Zhangguo Army; he was transferred to Associate Commissioner of the Supin Circuit, changed to the Guide Army, and served successively as Prefect of Hai and Pi prefectures — all with concurrent charge of overall command of troops and horses.
translations.idiomatic: When the Judicial Commission reported his record in the Zhangguo Army command, he was promoted to Associate Commissioner of the Supin Circuit, transferred to the Guide Army, and served as Prefect of Hai and Pi prefectures, each with concurrent command of troops and horses.

sentences.zh: 宋統領劉文謙以兵犯宿遷，阿喜逆擊，破之。

translations.literal: The Song commander Liu Wenqian invaded Suqian with troops; A Xi met him in counterattack and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song commander Liu Wenqian attacked Suqian, A Xi met him in counterattack and routed his force.

sentences.zh: 複破戚春、夏興國舟兵萬餘人，斬夏興國於陣。

translations.literal: He again defeated the river forces of Qi Chun and Xia Xingguo numbering more than ten thousand, and beheaded Xia Xingguo on the battlefield.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated the riverine forces of Qi Chun and Xia Xingguo, more than ten thousand strong, and slew Xia Xingguo in battle.

sentences.zh: 遷鎮國上將軍，再賜銀幣，為元帥左監軍紇石列執中前鋒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General Who Stabilizes the State, again granted silver and coins, and served as vanguard for the Left Army Supervisor Heshilie Zhizhong under the commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to General Who Stabilizes the State and again granted silver and coins, he served as vanguard for the Left Army Supervisor Heshilie Zhizhong under the commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 渡淮，破寶應、天長二縣。

translations.literal: Crossing the Huai, he defeated Bao'ying and Tianchang counties.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Huai River, he captured Bao'ying and Tianchang counties.

sentences.zh: 師還，遷同知歸德府事，改泗州防禦使。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was transferred to Associate Prefect of Guide Prefecture and changed to Defense Commissioner of Si Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign he was made Associate Prefect of Guide Prefecture and then Defense Commissioner of Si Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，起複。

translations.literal: Upon his mother's death he entered mourning and was then recalled to service.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother's death he was recalled to office.

sentences.zh: 大安二年，改華州防禦使，遷鎮南軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Da'an he was changed to Defense Commissioner of Hua Prefecture and transferred to Military Commissioner of the Zhennan Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Da'an (1210) he was made Defense Commissioner of Hua Prefecture and promoted to Military Commissioner of the Zhennan Army.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，改知大名府，充馬軍都提控，曆橫海、安化軍節度使，充宣差山東路左翼都提控。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he was changed to Prefect of Daming, made Overall Commander of the Cavalry Army, served successively as Military Commissioner of the Henghai and Anhua armies, and made Imperial Commissioner and Overall Commander of the Left Wing of the Shandong Eastern Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou (1214) he was made Prefect of Daming and Overall Commander of the Cavalry Army, served as Military Commissioner of the Henghai and Anhua armies, and was appointed Imperial Commissioner and Overall Commander of the Left Wing of the Shandong Eastern Circuit.

sentences.zh: 尋知濟南府事，徙沁南軍節度使，遷河南統軍使，兼昌武軍節度使，卒。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he became Prefect of Jinan, was moved to Military Commissioner of the Qinnan Army, transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Henan with concurrent post as Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made Prefect of Jinan, transferred to Military Commissioner of the Qinnan Army, then Commander-in-Chief of Henan with concurrent post as Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：金諸宗室，自始祖至康宗凡八世。

translations.literal: The praise says: Among the Jin imperial clan, from the Founding Ancestor to Emperor Kangzong there were eight generations in all.
translations.idiomatic: The appraiser writes: Among the Jin imperial clan, from the Founding Ancestor to Emperor Kangzong there were eight generations in all.

sentences.zh: 獻祖徙居海姑水納葛里村，再徙安出虎水。

translations.literal: Ancestor Xian moved to Nageli Village on the Haigu River and again moved to the Anchuhu River.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor Xian moved to Nageli Village on the Haigu River and later relocated to the Anchuhu River.

sentences.zh: 世祖稱海姑兄弟，蓋指其所居也。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu was called a brother of Haigu — this refers to where they dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu was called a "brother of Haigu" — a reference to where the clan had settled.

sentences.zh: 完顏十二部，皆以部為氏，宣宗詔宗室皆書姓氏，然亦有部人以部為氏，非宗室同姓者，遂不可辨矣。

translations.literal: The twelve Wanyan tribes all took their tribe as surname; Emperor Xuanzong ordered the imperial clan all to write surnames, yet there were also tribal people who took their tribe as surname though not of the same surname as the imperial clan — and so they could no longer be distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve Wanyan tribes had all taken their tribal name as a surname; Emperor Xuanzong ordered the imperial clan to record surnames in writing, yet ordinary tribesmen also used tribal names as surnames without sharing the imperial clan's lineage — and the two could no longer be told apart.
